statuses.verified-current: Official organizer URL and organizer identity match; deadline/current status checked; fees disclosed; compensation/award information checked when applicable; artist-rights or usage terms reviewed where available; verification is recent enough for the opportunity.
statuses.needs-recheck: The opportunity may be legitimate, but one or more required checks are missing, stale, or available only through a discovery source.
statuses.flagged: A material mismatch, misleading term, broken official source, unresolved artist-rights concern, or serious verification problem requires review.
statuses.expired: Deadline has passed and the call is not recorded as rolling.

review_policy.purpose: Community reviews document artist experience with a call or host organization.
review_policy.separation: Reviews do not automatically alter validity status.
review_policy.moderation: Public GitHub-hosted reviews may be removed or moderated for privacy violations, threats, spam, impersonation, doxxing, or clearly unrelated content.
review_policy.evidence: Users are encouraged to describe dates, communication, payment, contracts, artwork handling, exhibition follow-through and other concrete experience.
